environment.description: EC2 instance (m5.large) running the Flask monolith in us-east-1a. The Split Proxy relay at FEATURE_SERVICE_URL is configured with the 'legacy-sql-search-v2' flag set to treatment='on' for all traffic (100% rollout) as part of a gradual migration that was paused mid-way. The application is exposed via an ALB with no additional filtering rules. SQLite database contains production order data.

config.network: ALB -> EC2 port 5000, no WAF attached
config.split_proxy: relay running on localhost:8080, SDK key configured
